title: Workplace injury reporting
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Write an incident page.
3. Include details about the time, location, and participants.
4. Describe the sequence of events leading to the accident.
5. Document the injuries and any medical treatment provided.
6. Record the immediate action taken after the accident.
7. Include witness statements.
8. Photograph the scene and any equipment involved if possible.
9. Assess and document any damage to property.
10. Conduct an investigation to determine the root cause.
11. Compile all relevant data into a comprehensive report.
12. Include preventive measures and recommendations for future risk reduction.
13. Ensure compliance with legal and organizational standards.
14. Submit the report to the appropriate parties and regulatory bodies.
15. Provide necessary follow-ups and revisions as required.<|end_of_text|>
